title: Deconstruction of Historical 1-Participant Ablation Claims
description: Statistical power and significance audit of claimed single-participant diagnostic improvements.

case_study.scientific_critique: A difference of exactly 1 participant in a clinical cohort of N=58 yields exactly b=0, c=1 (1 discordant pair). Under the null hypothesis of equal performance, the exact two-sided binomial p-value is 1.000. Describing a 1-participant fluctuation as an algorithmic breakthrough or evidence of model superiority is mathematically invalid and constitutes overclaiming. In the revised manuscript, single-participant differences must be transparently reported as statistically indistinguishable random variations.
